indicator: Synthetic-drug production and storage sites dismantled
source: Politie, Nationaal Overzicht Drugslocaties (via NDM); 2025 from the police's own overview
drug_specific: No (all synthetic drugs; MDMA and amphetamine dominate)
bias_limitations: Enforcement-driven; not MDMA-specific; production for export is a large share.

indicator: Dumpings of synthetic-drug waste
source: Politie, Nationaal Overzicht Drugslocaties (via NDM); 2025 from the police's own overview
bias_limitations: Only dumpings found and reported; most direct crime harm of the MDMA market, but shared with amphetamine.

indicator: Costs of cleaning up drug waste
source: BIJ12 subsidy data (via Het Misdaadbureau / NPO Radio 1)
bias_limitations: Only the two provinces with published figures, and only dumpings with a subsidy request (more requests may follow). Summed over the units that report, so a lower bound: the national total is higher. Shared with amphetamine.

indicator: Pre-precursors seized (all synthetic drugs; PMK-type = MDMA)
bias_limitations: Few, lumpy years (single large seizures); PMK-type share derived by summing chemical types.

indicator: OM investigations into synthetic drugs
bias_limitations: Reflects OM priorities; not MDMA-specific.

indicator: Ecstasy seized by Douane (kg and number)
bias_limitations: Enforcement-driven; the jump in the number of seizures from 2020 (with stable kg) suggests many small shipments, e.g. parcels (not verified).

indicator: Registered hard-drug offences (Opiumwet list I)
bias_limitations: Not MDMA-specific; enforcement measure.

indicator: Price per ecstasy pill and per gram of MDMA powder
bias_limitations: Prices reported by people testing their drugs; very stable.

indicator: Perceived drug use / dealing nuisance in neighbourhood
bias_limitations: Not drug-specific.

indicator: GI-TOC Organized Crime Index: synthetic drug trade score, Netherlands
bias_limitations: Only three points; expert judgement.

indicator: Ecstasy use: lifetime, last year, last month
bias_limitations: Self-report; mostly occasional use (only 7.8% of users use monthly or more).
dataset_columns: h01_lastyear_use_pct; h01_lastmonth_use_pct; h01_lifetime_use_pct; h01_lifetime_use_18plus_pct; h01_lastyear_use_18plus_pct; h01_lastmonth_use_18plus_pct

indicator: Lifetime ecstasy use among pupils 12–16
bias_limitations: School-based.

indicator: Ecstasy use among mbo students
bias_limitations: Few points.

indicator: Clients in addiction care with ecstasy as primary / secondary problem
bias_limitations: Very small numbers; same institution-base caveats as for cocaine and cannabis.

indicator: Drug incidents involving ecstasy (MDI)
bias_limitations: Mostly event first aid, so counts depend on the number of events (very low in 2020–21); 2019 and 2022 still to extract.

indicator: Deaths from psychostimulants (incl. MDMA and amphetamine)
bias_limitations: Not MDMA-specific; small numbers. A dedicated drug-death register is in preparation.

indicator: Hospital admissions with ecstasy diagnosis
access: Not published per drug in NDM ecstasy chapter
bias_limitations: Candidate: request LBZ data on MDMA poisonings.

indicator: MDMA in wastewater (Amsterdam, Eindhoven, Utrecht, Rotterdam)
bias_limitations: Sensitive to events in the sampling week and to tourism; discharge of production waste could also inflate values (not verified).

indicator: MDMA content per pill, share of high-dose pills, MDMA powder purity
bias_limitations: Self-selected samples; high-dose share derived from the dose distribution.

indicator: Lasting complaints after ecstasy use (e.g. HPPD), specialised clinic
bias_limitations: Clinic sample, no time series.

indicator: Published court rulings mentioning MDMA
example_values: Count of rulings with 'xtc testen' per year (not yet computed)
bias_limitations: Only a small, non-random share of rulings is published (serious and appealed cases over-represented). Useful for roles, quantities and sentences rather than volume.
status: Blocked (data.rechtspraak.nl not on this session's network allowlist)

indicator: Poison centre (NVIC) consultations involving MDMA
bias_limitations: Telephone consultations by professionals and the public, not cases; depends on how often people call and on awareness. The all-ages series (2021–2024) and the 13+ series (2020–2022) come from different report tables and should not be mixed. Older yearly reports (RIVM, 2003–2019) can extend the series. Website risk calculations (from 2023) are a separate, larger count.

indicator: Antenne Amsterdam: trends in use and treatment intake in Amsterdam
bias_limitations: Amsterdam only, partly qualitative, survey groups vary by year; good for early signals and validation of national series.

indicator: Google Trends search interest for drug-related terms
bias_limitations: Relative index (0–100), not counts; reflects news and curiosity as much as use; sampling noise for rare terms. Creative proxy, to use only for validation or timing.

indicator: MDMA labs dismantled
bias_limitations: Four points, from three editions; enforcement-driven; the 2025 drop coincides with fewer dumpings, but the police call the causes unclear.

indicator: National fund for cleaning up drug waste (Decentralisatie-uitkering)
source: Ministries of JenV and IenW, VNG
example_values: €3 million budget for 2026; Halsteren clean-up cost 'millions'
bias_limitations: Budget, not cost; municipalities under-claim; earlier provincial subsidy schemes differ by province. Could give a cost series if payouts are published.

indicator: Dutch-produced MDMA seized abroad and darknet sales by Dutch vendors
source: EUDA/Europol EU Drug Markets; academic darknet studies
example_values: Netherlands repeatedly named the main EU source of MDMA
bias_limitations: No yearly series; captures harm the Dutch market causes elsewhere, which an index of harm in the Netherlands may or may not count.

indicator: Drivers testing positive for amphetamines (incl. MDMA) in police blood samples
example_values: Amphetamines (speed and XTC) in 30% of positive samples (2017–2023); blood samples 4,450 (2021) → 28,841 (2025), all drugs
bias_limitations: MDMA and amphetamine reported together; driven by police checks.
status: Checked (two points in data frame; drug shares pooled)

indicator: Ecstasy use among nightlife visitors and young adults
example_values: Club/festival visitors Amsterdam: ecstasy 48% (2022); nightlife young adults, last year: 53.8% (latest NDM chart)
bias_limitations: Convenience samples (online, venue-based); methods change between waves. Better reflects the group most at risk than the general population.

indicator: DIMS samples and warnings (Red Alerts) for dangerous ecstasy pills
example_values: 2024: 18,408 samples, 52% ecstasy pills; 2.5% of pills >210 mg
bias_limitations: Warnings are not counted consistently per year in the reports; sample mix follows who visits test services.
